message: You fill the canister at the Gremlin Fountain. The water is neither warm nor cold. The Gremlin seems to wink. For a second, you'd swear it glowed.
The rack hisses and cools down. Then every screen in the wing flashes red: ROGUE PROCESS DETECTED. UPLINK ACTIVE.
The Broker opens the envelope, smiles, and hands you a photo. It is a photo of you. Not a good one.
Lorna Coinlore reads it live: 'THE PRESIDENT IS OPENING A DOOR. FOR EVERYONE.' Somewhere, the Treasury cheers.
Following the blueprints, you reconnect three cables and one very confusing lever. The old stone warms under your hand. Lights flicker on in patterns no electrician would sign off.
You slot in the Coordinates Drive. A screen blinks: DESTINATION SET. OUTSIDE. OLD WORLD.
The Power Cell clicks into place. The chamber starts to hum, then purr.
You feed the Exit Permit into a slot marked PAPERWORK. The chamber stamps it. Approved.
The chamber swallows 5 Scrap Hash and roars to life. Then the old gate stones beside it grind upright, and the doors slam shut: NOBODY LEAVES.
You toss some Scrap Hash into the fountain. Nothing happens. The Gremlin looks unimpressed.
